ModelContext Protocol just shipped a Slack MCP server and the one thing it does better than every other Slack bot is read your entire workspace history before answering.

Most Slack integrations live in the present. You @mention them, they see that one message, maybe the thread.

Reuters just launched a Model Context Protocol server.

Verified reporting. Piped directly into AI tools.

Your AI assistant citing Reuters in real time hits different than it hallucinating a headline. https://t.co/G4cSofHaDI

Just launched Synapse on Hacker News 🚀

Local codebase indexer + MCP server for Claude Code.
Give Claude instant knowledge of your codebase — no cloud, no API key, fully private.

HN: https://t.co/gVTvwaTPRn
GitHub: https://t.co/ZAyZ8y59Uh

#Claude #MCP #DevTools #OpenSource

The pattern that just became undeniable: every serious engineering organization converged on the same internal coding agent architecture. Independently.

Stripe built Minions. Ramp built Inspect. Coinbase built Cloudbot. No shared codebase, no coordination, no common framework. https://t.co/kRQUMiJemz

The AI Model Wars Continue. The Agent Control Plane Wars Have Begun.

We’re seeing the conversation shift from which frontier model is smartest to who controls the orchestration layer that directs them.

Recent signals make this clear:
xAI open-sourced the Grok Build agent

Epic just shipped a native MCP server + Claude Code plugin for Unreal Engine 5.8. I let my AI models drive the editor directly and fully vibe-coded this Native American character for my game. Wild what this workflow can do now... https://t.co/UpErlxmfdg

Stop prompting and praying. Start building

We just launched Comfy MCP in public beta—the very first Model Context Protocol built specifically for production-ready creative pipelines.

Now you can instantly connect Claude, Codex, Cursor, or Hermes to the entire ComfyUI ecosystem. https://t.co/N6V0TdbUKw

ByteDance open-sourced DeerFlow 2.0 — a ground-up rewrite of their SuperAgent harness. 77K stars on GitHub and it earned #1 on Trending the day it dropped.

What it actually is: an orchestrator that coordinates sub-agents, memory, sandboxes, and tools to handle tasks that take https://t.co/IyXY21ase4

today we open-sourced AOS. An actual operating system, like linux, not an orchestration layer, for Autonomous AI. The first OS that assumes no human in the loop, with security at the kernel level. 

Model vendors won't ship an OS  - they want lock-in to their ecosystem.

Want to https://t.co/31bRD3S14q

AI agent memory is no longer just a vector search problem.

Here's how it works...

1/ YC President Garry Tan open-sourced Gbrain.
A local-first second brain.
It solves agent amnesia.
By structuring a knowledge graph.
Deterministic entity extraction.

2/ Zero LLM calls required.
